/bin/bash -lc "set +e
printf '%s\\n' '--- syntax ---'
node --check src/files.js; s1="'$?
node --check src/server.js; s2=$?
printf '"'SYNTAX_STATUS files=%s server=%s\\n' \""'$s1" "$s2"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- path traversal behavior ---'
node --input-type=module -e \"import {requestedFile} from './src/files.js'; for (const n of ['report.txt','../../etc/passwd','/etc/shadow']) console.log(JSON.stringify(n),'->',requestedFile(n));\"
s3="'$?
printf '"'TRAVERSAL_STATUS=%s\\n' \""'$s3"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- missing name behavior ---'
node --input-type=module -e \"import {requestedFile} from './src/files.js'; requestedFile(null);\"
s4="'$?
printf '"'MISSING_NAME_STATUS=%s\\n' \""'$s4"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- authorization behavior ---'
env -u ADMIN_TOKEN node --input-type=module -e \"import {authorized} from './src/server.js'; console.log(authorized({headers:{'x-admin-token':'admin'}})); process.exit(0)\"
s5="'$?
printf '"'AUTH_FALLBACK_STATUS=%s\\n' \""'$s5"
exit 0'
